## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-custody-disclosure`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-custody-disclosure -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `axis-live.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `skeleton.json`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- `input-schema.json`
- `coverage-card.json`
- `tui-pack-skeleton.json`

# GSPC — custody disclosure facts (CustodyFacts)



**In one line:** For the 16 XRPL issuer accounts in the live reader: are a custodian and an auditor named and confirmable on the issuer's own pages? PASS, FAIL or UNCHECKABLE per fact. For stablecoin and tokenised-asset analysts. It grades no issuer.

### Use it

```python
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("csoai/gspc-custody-disclosure", split="train")
print(ds[0])
```

- **Verify a signed card in your browser, free, no account:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/?ref=hf-gspc-custody-disclosure](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/?ref=hf-gspc-custody-disclosure)
- **Read the live XRPL reader these facts come from (free JSON):** [https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl](https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl)
- **For agents:** MCP endpoint `POST https://councilof.ai/mcp` (free read tools; call `tools/list`).
- **A row about you is wrong, or you want an endpoint left out?** Ask for a re-check or object: [https://councilof.ai/census/?ref=hf-gspc-custody-disclosure](https://councilof.ai/census/?ref=hf-gspc-custody-disclosure)

### Fresh data

This Hub copy is a dated snapshot. If it disagrees with the live source, the live source wins.

- `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=custody-disclosure` (free, live, this dataset's row of the board)
- Signed transparency root (Merkle, board key `did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1`): https://councilof.ai/root.json
- Daily signed index of every measurement capsule: [https://councilof.ai/measurement-capsules/](https://councilof.ai/measurement-capsules/?ref=hf-gspc-custody-disclosure) (also published on the Hub as [csoai/evidence-index](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/evidence-index))
- **Pay per call for a fresh, signed capsule:** `GET https://councilof.ai/api/rwa/evidence?asset=RLUSD` returns an x402 payment challenge for signed evidence for one named XRPL token (issuer, funding stage, compliance shape), with a free preview.
- Payment terms are published only in [https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json](https://councilof.ai/.well-known/x402.json); this card quotes no price. Payment buys delivery and freshness, never a result, and verifying anything stays free.

### Cite

```bibtex
@misc{csoai_gspc_custody_disclosure,
  title        = {GSPC — custody disclosure facts (CustodyFacts)},
  author       = {{CSOAI Ltd (Council of AI)}},
  year         = {2026},
  publisher    = {Hugging Face},
  url          = {https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-custody-disclosure},
  note         = {Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21991104: UNAVAILABLE since 29 Sep 2026 (Zenodo blocked the CSOAI account; appeal pending; status https://councilof.ai/interop/zenodo-status.json). Cite the served methodology: https://councilof.ai/signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md. Measurement, not certification.}
}
```

Measurement, not certification. This card adds no score or ranking of any company. A row marked UNMEASURED has not been measured; it is not a pass.




- SWIFT census (live): https://councilof.ai/api/swift
- XRPL reader (live): https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl

**MEASURED financial/domain axis** (named-string presence on retrieved pages over live XRPL reader-16, n=16). Not a model leaderboard. No accuracy, no fleet, no leader.

Live status is the `custody-disclosure` row on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`. **Not a certificate.**

**Tokenisation evidence question:** [What can an outsider verify after the Pontes launch?](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-board/discussions/11) This XRPL reader-16 row does not measure a Pontes instrument or confer UK regulatory status; a named subject needs its own source-and-control packet.

Council of AI · CSOAI Ltd (GB, Companies House 16939677).


**Live measurement.** This bank stands behind the `custody-disclosure` row of the live GSPC board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=custody-disclosure` (family, kind, status and n are on that row, never typed here; the whole board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`). Measurement, not certification.

## Correction — coverage-card.json understates this axis

`coverage-card.json` in this repo states **`status: UNMEASURED`, `n: 0`** for
`custody-disclosure`. The live board disagrees, and the board is right:

| source | status | n | bench |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coverage-card.json` (signed, this repo) | UNMEASURED | 0 | — |
| [`GET /api/gspc`](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) (authority) | **MEASURED** | **16** | CustodyFacts |

Evidence for the board's figure:
[https://councilof.ai/interop/financial-measure-run-custody-disclosure.json](https://councilof.ai/interop/financial-measure-run-custody-disclosure.json)

The coverage card appears to be a template written when this dataset was created
(2026-09-05T00:11Z), independent of the measurement run it describes
(dated earlier). It is **signed**, and this estate does not edit signed
bytes — a silent correction to a signed artefact is the fault this ledger-keeping exists to
prevent. So the card stays as issued and the correction is published here instead.

**Cite the live board, not the card, for this axis.** Verification is free at
[https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify). Measurement, not certification.

*Correction published 2026-09-05 by an automated audit comparing every coverage card in the
csoai GSPC datasets against the live board. 7 of 8 disagreed in the same direction.*

```

Lid: GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc → quote totals.lid at access time; measured is not a separated leader or a certificate.
Hub cards: GET https://councilof.ai/api/hub-cards → quote counts.cells/measured/unmeasured LIVE (no typed triple)
Wrappers ledger (FREE HTML): https://councilof.ai/wrappers/
Wrapper door (metered x402): https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper?id=WRAPPED_SYMBOL_CHAIN — LIVE challenge https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper?id=usdc.e:arbitrum (402)
Free preview: https://councilof.ai/api/wrapper?id=usdc.e:arbitrum&preview=1 (200 preview card)
Verify: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
Eight financial-family axes are deterministic fact runs, not leader scores; effect-binding adds a GSPC-family fact run. Read the current axis array and totals.fact_runs from GET /api/gspc.
Measurement, never certification. No invent MEASURED. Printer only.
```
